construct: SLC25A15 encodes ORNT1, the mitochondrial ornithine transporter that moves cytosolic ornithine into the mitochondrial matrix. Loss deprives the urea cycle of intramitochondrial ornithine, causing hyperammonemia, hyperornithinemia, and homocitrullinuria.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Post-protein hyperammonemia with hyperornithinemia, homocitrullinuria, and biallelic SLC25A15 variants identifies HHH syndrome. ORNT1 imports cytosolic ornithine into the mitochondrial matrix for the urea cycle.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Citrulline export, mitochondrial pyruvate transport, aspartate shuttling, and the carnitine shuttle are separate mitochondrial transport processes and do not produce the HHH biochemical triad.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The named transporter gene and diagnostic triad uniquely determine cytosol-to-matrix ornithine import.
